audit.whatIsWrong: Nine fields (winCon, enemyWin, loading x2, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, report[9].t) call Hwei's CC ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. Per enemyAbilities his slots are P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair — there is no 'Subject: Fear'. 'CC Paints' loosely matches the real behavior (E's cast set is the crowd-control spells: Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw) but the base ability is Subject: Torment (E).
audit.why: This is the exact fabricated-name failure mode called out in the calibration notes (Brand's 'Ares of Blaze'); a player tracking 'Subject: Fear' on Hwei's bar will never find it.
audit.corrected: Replaced every occurrence with 'Subject: Torment (E)', the real ability name, across all affected fields (capped report rewrites at two: report[5] and report[9], both of which named the fabricated ability).

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1], spikes[0].text and early all describe Milio's 'Q heal-shield' or 'Q shield' as the tool that loses the early poke war. Per ownerKit, Milio's Q (Ultra Mega Fire Kick) only knocks back and slows — it has no heal or shield flag. The shield ability is E (2 charges); Q's counterpart in this fight is the E shield, not Q.
audit.why: Same class of error as the Q/cleanse mix-up found on other matchups this run: attributing an effect to the wrong ability slot teaches the wrong button to press.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the three fields to credit E's shield instead of a nonexistent 'Q heal-shield'.
sources: brief ownerKit Q and E ability text/flags

audit.whatIsWrong: late text credits 'the Q kick's attack-speed and range buff' to Milio's Q. Q has no attack-speed or range flag; the range buff is W's (Cozy Campfire zone increases attack range to allies inside it). No ownerKit flag supports an attack-speed component on any ability, so that magnitude has no source.
audit.why: Wrong ability slot again, plus an unsourced attack-speed claim the calibration notes warn against (magnitude without a kit source).
audit.corrected: Changed 'the Q kick's attack-speed and range buff' to 'the W zone's range buff', dropping the unverified attack-speed claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and spikes[1].text call Hwei's R (Spiraling Despair) a 'root'. enemyKit lists only a 'slow' flag on Hwei R, no hardCC/root flag, and the ability text itself says 'expanding painting that slows and damages' — no root wording.
audit.why: Calling a slow a root overstates the CC (roots and slows call for different counterplay — Flash beats a root, kiting beats a slow) and could mislead positioning advice.
audit.corrected: Changed 'root' to 'slow' in both fields. Left the deeper claim in spikes[1] ('R cleanses slows... but can't remove it') alone rather than asserting Milio's cleanse does or doesn't work against it — that specific interaction isn't confirmed by the kit text and is recorded as unverified below.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged wants.foe[1] 'Spiraling Despair' as a possible misspelling, but it exactly matches enemyAbilities.R — false positive from the near-miss matcher, no fix needed.
